consequence.statement: No operational consequence: the new tenantID option is optional, existing AzureDNS solver configuration keeps working unchanged, and operators in multi-tenant environments may set it to specify the tenant ID when using managed identities.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds a new optional configuration option `tenantID` on the AzureDNS DNS-01 solver's managed identity configuration (spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID on Issuer/ClusterIssuer), letting users specify the tenant ID when using managed identities with service principals in multi-tenant environments.
